reason: I trust the creator, but $68 today for a bottle and filters, plus another subscription to manage, is more than I want to spend when my problem is really just forgetting the bottle I already own. A 5% code barely moves it.
objection: It's still $40-50 for a water bottle, and the filter plan means I keep paying forever for something I'm not sure tap water even needs.
would_change_my_mind: A real creator discount (20% or more) or the bottle with a filter at around $30 with no subscription required.
